INR6,500 is a user quote for one room for two, unverified. Check all-in taxes, room type, cancellation, early checkout and late-return access before purchase. Listing says no breakfast; buy ahead for Monday 06:45 breakfast/checkout. Keep the confirmed Hong Kong room and main luggage; small overnight bag only.
Outbound: 27 Dec 07:30 TurboJET Sheung Wan → Outer Harbour, about 60 min. Taxi 05:55, reach Shun Tak around 06:40. Current published weekend daytime economy HKD212/person, HKD424/two. Return: 28 Dec 09:00 Cotai Water Jet Taipa → Sheung Wan, about 60 min; standard weekday daytime Cotai Class MOP192/person, MOP384/two. Both remain placeholders; published patterns are not December ticket inventory. Follow actual cutoffs.
Bungy remains a placeholder: 14:00 target, 13:30 ticketing-counter check-in, allow through an estimated 16:00; no guaranteed finish. Confirm Meghana’s spectator/observation access.
Carry both passports, valid Hong Kong re-entry documents, actual confirmations once booked and small MOP cash. Verify data for BOTH 27 and 28 Dec, including activation/expiry. Preserve Macau Money / Transport Payments guidance. No beef or beef broth.
Morning: timed Wharf → historic centre → Grand Lisboa/original Lisboa exteriors → Tower. Evening: Asia → Galaxy (two lobbies) → Venetian/dinner → Parisian → Londoner → MGM Cotai → Wynn fountains → Asia. This is a long day. Protect meals, bungy and ferry buffers; shorten browsing/gaming-floor looks first, then skip Londoner show waiting and reach MGM/Wynn earlier.

changes.label: Macau LRT — Airport, Cotai and morning ferry

values.title: Macau LRT — Pai Kok and morning ferry
values.summary: Asia → Pai Kok → Taipa Ferry · MOP10/person budget · 07:15 start · 07:40 taxi fallback
values.body:
Asia Boutique is by Rua do Cunha in Taipa Village, NOT next to Airport station. Monday breakfast/checkout 06:45–07:15; listing says no breakfast, so buy ahead. Walk to Pai Kok → direct Taipa Line towards Taipa Ferry Terminal → terminal walk. Allow 45–55 min door-to-door including walking, tickets, waiting and contingency; target terminal 08:10. Current Monday service starts 06:30, roughly every 5–10.5 min; verify station departure on date. Budget MOP10/person, MOP20/two for single tokens, verify actual fare selector.
Simpler fallback: ask reception the previous evening for a taxi around 07:40; MOP45–75/car planning estimate, 15–25 min including pickup, target 08:10. Switch promptly if the LRT plan slips; do not wait for a Monday village shuttle.
Late Sunday: Wynn lake → Cotai East LRT towards Barra → Pai Kok → hotel walk, 35–45 min, MOP8/person / MOP16/two token budget; verify last train. Taxi MOP45–75/car, 15–25 min, is the default after 23:15.
Tower → Asia by LRT is indirect via reaching Barra, then towards Taipa Ferry Terminal to Pai Kok and walking; MOP8–12/person / MOP16–24/two token budget, 45–60 min. Taxi MOP70–110/car, 20–30 min is the time-saving default. LRT does not directly serve Senado or Outer Harbour.

changes.label: Macau transport — practical route and alternatives

values.summary: Numeric taxi/token allowances · Taipa Village shuttle hours/direction · No late hotel shuttle
values.body:
All ranges are one-way planning estimates for two adults unless explicitly a published fare; actual meter, waiting, traffic, tolls and surcharges win. Keep HKD/MOP amounts in their original currency; use a real exchange rate if converting.
Hong Kong hotel → Sheung Wan: licensed taxi HKD180–260/car, 30–45 min; arrange 05:55 to target 06:40. Conditional MTR HKD15–25/person / HKD30–50/two, 45–60 min; not the early default without first-train verification.
Wharf → Senado taxi MOP45–75/car, 20–25 min; walking free MOP0, 40–50 min requires retiming. Lisboa → Tower taxi MOP35–60/car, allow 25 min; walk free MOP0, 35–45 min is unsuitable near 13:30 check-in. Tower → Asia taxi MOP70–110/car, 20–30 min. No guessed bus routes or unverified Senado shuttle.
Asia → Galaxy walk free MOP0, 15–25 min to the correct lobby; taxi MOP25–45/car, 10–20 min. Galaxy → Venetian walk free MOP0, 15–20 min; taxi MOP25–45/car, 10–20 min. Venetian → Parisian and Parisian → Londoner: walk free MOP0, 15–20 min each. Londoner → MGM taxi MOP25–45/car, 15 min; walk free MOP0, 20–30 min. MGM → Wynn lake walk free MOP0, 15–20 min; taxi MOP25–45/car, 10–20 min. Wynn → Asia late taxi MOP45–75/car, 15–25 min. Pai Kok/token alternatives are in the LRT note.
Optional published visitor shuttles, not an Asia Boutique service:
• Taipa Village near Rua do Cunha ↔ Parisian: Fri–Sun 11:00–19:00 every 12–15 min, MOP0; allow 25–40 min door-to-door. Confirm exact stop. It goes to Parisian, so choosing it means reorder/reduce browsing, not a Parisian→Venetian→Parisian detour. No Monday service under this pattern.
• Wynn Palace → Old Taipa Village → Lisboeta → Palace: Thu–Sun 12:00–21:00 every 30 min, MOP0. Village→Wynn goes via Lisboeta; confirm bay/direction and allow waiting/walks. No 23:15 return and no assumed 21:00 departure at every intermediate stop.
• MGM Macau ↔ Tower ↔ MGM Cotai: 09:00–23:30 every 10–15 min; Tower stops only 11:00–21:00. MOP0, budget 30–45 min including wait. Useful only for a re-anchored Tower→MGM visit, not direct to Asia and no guaranteed 16:30 show arrival. Confirm bay/direction/capacity.
• Wynn Palace → HZMB → Taipa Ferry → Airport → Palace: published loop about 30–40 min until 21:00. An airport visitor alternative only; not a direct hotel transfer or a reason to return to the former airport base.

changes.label: Cotai evening — shows, closures and fallback order

values.title: Cotai shows and evening fallbacks
values.summary: Galaxy: Diamond + Crystal · Dinner protected · Londoner facade 21:30 · MGM interiors · Wynn late fountains
values.body:
Default 27 Dec: Asia 17:00 → Galaxy 17:15–18:15 (Diamond AND Crystal) → Venetian 18:35–19:15 → paid dinner 19:15–20:00 → Parisian exterior 20:15–20:35 → Londoner 20:55–21:45 / optional facade 21:30 → MGM Cotai 22:00–22:25 → Wynn fountains 22:45–23:15 → taxi to Asia. Transfer blocks are separate in the itinerary.
Galaxy shows are in TWO different lobbies: Sunday Diamond Lobby 10:00–00:00 every 30 min, Crystal Lobby 10:15–23:45 every 30 min. Ask staff for the next pair/internal walk, e.g. Diamond 17:30 then Crystal 17:45 if achievable, or Crystal 17:15 then Diamond 17:30. Allow up to an hour, no simultaneous viewing promise. Fortune Diamond is the same diamond attraction, not a third show.
Parisian exterior lights general schedule 18:15–00:00 every 15 min; target 20:15 or 20:30 fallback. Observation decks listed CLOSED 26 Dec–1 Jan; exterior only, verify lighting/maintenance.
Londoner outdoor facade daily 19:30–23:30 hourly: be outside about 21:25 for 21:30 if timing allows. Indoor guard is Crystal Palace, Sunday 16:00 / 18:00 / 20:30, closed Monday. Default 20:55 arrival misses the guard; earlier guard is an optional substitution only. Different indoor/outdoor locations.
MGM late visit is for Spectacle atrium/interiors and permitted brief gaming-floor look, not a promised show. Current operator promotes Enchanted Garden Odyssey with flying ladybugs, daily 13:00 / 15:00 / 16:30 / 18:00. Tourism still describes Sea Odyssey dolphins at 13:00/15:00/17:00/19:00 but the old operator URL redirects. Dolphin operation/date remains UNCONFIRMED; ask MGM. Do not relabel ladybugs as dolphins. If a daytime show is prioritised/confirmed, re-anchor MGM and reduce/substitute another block, with recalculated transfers.
Wynn Palace evening fountains 18:00–00:00 every 20 min; catch a display without a guaranteed song/minute. SkyCab optional only, no reserved queue or required last-entry target.
Long day, not a relaxed plan: protect meals, bungy check-in and ferry margins. Shorten gaming-floor looks and browsing first, skip Londoner show/wait next, and reach MGM/Wynn earlier. Longer Galaxy waits use Londoner slack. Stop earlier if tired; do not promise every show.

changes.label: Pandas — skip by default; Sunday alternative only

values.title: Pandas and optional resort substitutions
values.summary: Untimed early-finish branch · Reduce another resort/show · Monte Fort / Golden Reel / Palace optional
values.body:
Pandas are an untimed early-finish branch, not an extra guaranteed attraction. Seac Pai Van pavilion normally closes Mondays; Sunday afternoon closes 17:00 with last entry 16:45. Recheck maintenance/holiday admission. If completely done with bungy around 14:30–15:00, taxi directly to the park allowing 25–35 min driving/queue, view 45–60 min, then hotel. If done after about 15:15, skip. Choosing pandas must reduce a resort block or omit a show. No guaranteed jump finish, panda activity or sightings.
Monte Fort stays unscheduled/optional; neither traveller is interested. Golden Reel, Grand Lisboa Palace in Cotai, MGM Macau on the Peninsula, Wynn Macau, Studio City/teamLab and extra properties are substitutions only, not additional timed stops. Grand Lisboa/original Hotel Lisboa are different Peninsula properties and are in the morning core. MGM Cotai and both Galaxy shows are now core evening visits; do not silently omit them. Never imply all Macau casinos fit in one evening.

values.title: Casino sightseeing and refreshments
values.body:
Sightseeing without gambling. Public atriums/lobbies/shopping areas are distinct from gaming floors. Brief public gaming-floor looks may be permitted at Grand Lisboa/Lisboa, Galaxy, Venetian, Parisian, Londoner, MGM Cotai and Wynn Palace, subject to security/access; private/salon areas excluded. Macau casino-entry age is 21: carry original passports for checks. No hotel stay or gambling spend is required by this sightseeing plan. Observe from public aisles; do not crowd tables or sit at gaming positions simply to watch. No photography, video or audio recording on gaming floors. Follow local photo signs in public interiors.
Do not rely on free meals/snacks or unconditional drinks. No current operator guarantee of premium snacks for non-gambling walk-ins was verified; policies can depend on membership, play/points, supply or staff discretion. At MGM/Galaxy, politely ask which refreshments are complimentary without playing or signing up, accept the answer and do not gamble to qualify. Anecdotal freebies are unverified, not confirmed benefits. Keep paid meals in the budget; no beef or beef broth.
values.summary: 21+ original passport · No gaming-floor recording · No gambling needed · Free snacks unverified
